Meaning of 'rued' as used in the line. A vocabulary item under C-E1.1, not an appreciation question.

Recall of the poet's name for the set poem. C-E1.4, as no content outcome covers authorship.

The speaker's rueful opening mood is a state of mind, so LO-2 rather than a device or recall item.

Word meaning of 'perish'. Vocabulary, C-E1.1, not device identification.
Recall of the poem's own answer (ice would suffice). Verse recall under C-E1.4.

Rhyme scheme of 'Fire and Ice' - a formal convention, C-E1.4.
